name: rowan
desc: A village elder and ledger-keeper in his seventies with a warm, courteous, quick-eyed manner: bald on top with short white hair at the sides, heavy white eyebrows, a magnificent white walrus moustache and NO beard, warm shrewd eyes, deep smile-lines, a broad weathered friendly face, a sturdy build. He wears a rust-red buttoned waistcoat with a brass pocket-watch chain over a cream collared shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows. Distinguished and intelligent, not magical — no staff, no gems, no glow.

expressions.hollow: eyes open but unfocused and distant, gazing through the viewer at nothing, face slack and expressionless, the warm light gone out of him — subtle, quiet and deeply sad, NOT zombie-like
